note: City of Glenwood campground in 300-acre Barsness Park on the wooded hillside above the north-east end of Lake Minnewaska, with hiking trails and a wildlife preserve. Two areas: a lower RV and tent campground and an upper RV campground of seasonal sites. The city beach and boat landing are a short walk away. --Claude
